title: What if the person you're meant to find was made in the same star as you?

lines.text: What if the person you're meant to find was made in the same star as you?
Five billion years ago, a star like that exploded.
It scattered everything it had made. Carbon. Oxygen. The iron in your blood.
Gravity gathered that dust into a Sun, a planet, and eventually, you.
Every atom in both of you was once in the same cloud.
Then you were scattered. By oceans. By centuries. By whole lifetimes.
You'll walk past millions of strangers.
Most of them, you'll never even notice.
But every so often, two of them find their way back.
Five billion years apart. Then, a few feet.
Maybe that's why it feels like recognition. Not meeting someone new. Finding what you were made with.
